post.summary: Find a LinkedIn company URL from a domain
post.description: Accepts only a company domain and returns only its LinkedIn company URL. Requires a current coded workspace API key; legacy Bubble-only keys are unsupported. The lookup deadline is 120 seconds; allow 130 seconds in the client. Billing runs asynchronously and never delays or changes the lookup result, including when credits are insufficient. Authentication and result storage must be available.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 0.5 credits on success, billed asynchronously. No-result and failed lookups cost zero. Pending charges retry later, including after a top-up.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Use the same key for transport retries of the same domain. Stored responses replay for seven days without another lookup or charge. In-flight duplicates return 409 with Retry-After: 2. Reusing a key with a different domain or after expiry returns 409. A new key starts a new operation. Without a key every request is a new operation.

requestBody.description: Exactly one domain field. Maximum JSON body size: 4 KiB.

domain.description: A company hostname without scheme, path, port, or credentials. Case and a leading www. are normalized.

200.description: A canonical LinkedIn company URL. Creates one asynchronous 0.5-credit charge.

400.description: Invalid JSON, domain, extra body fields, or Idempotency-Key.

404.description: No matching LinkedIn company URL found. Not charged.

409.description: Operation in progress, key reused for a different domain, or expired key. Retry in-flight operations with the same key; use a new key for conflicts or expiry.

Retry-After.description: Present for an in-flight duplicate: retry after 2 seconds.

413.description: JSON request body exceeds 4 KiB.

429.description: 180 requests per minute per workspace exceeded. Retry with bounded backoff.

503.description: Authentication, result storage, or lookup temporarily unavailable.

x-codeSamples.source:
import os
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "https://api.airscale.io/v1/find-companies/filter-values",
    headers={"Authorization": f'Bearer {os.environ["AIRSCALE_API_KEY"]}'},
    params={"filter": "industry", "q": "example"},
    timeout=30,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())

parameters.description: The Find Companies filter whose accepted values should be discovered.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At least one of q or query is required and must contain 2 to 120 characters after trimming. When q is present it is read first; a blank q suppresses query and returns 400.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: At least one of q or query is required and must contain 2 to 120 characters after trimming. query is used only when q is absent.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Omitted, non-numeric, or non-integer values default to 20; an explicit empty value becomes 0 then clamps to 1; integers below 1 clamp to 1; integers above 100 clamp to 100.

parameters.description: Optional country context supplied as repeat or comma-separated values.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Optional region context supplied as repeat or comma-separated values; a bare region name needs country context.

post.description: Retrieves one synchronous, cursor-paginated page of people who liked a LinkedIn post and enriches each returned profile.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Create a UUID for this page and reuse it with the identical endpoint, post_url, limit and cursor on every retry. Use a new key for the next page. Completed results are replayable for 24 hours after completion. Omitting the header is supported, but an independent retry without the original key can reserve credits again.

requestBody.description: Provide a LinkedIn post URL, an optional page size from 1 to 25, and the opaque cursor when continuing pagination. The JSON body must not exceed 128 KiB.

202.description: The bridge did not respond within 90 seconds. Its outcome is unconfirmed; retry the identical page with the returned key after Retry-After. This is not a completed result or a guarantee that processing started.

post.description: Creates a new active monitor for 1–10,000 personal LinkedIn profiles with one monitor ID, frequency, and optional webhook. Scans run asynchronously and large scans can take time. The first successful profile check establishes a baseline without emitting an event. If webhook_url is set, the 202 response includes a signing_secret exactly once. Each request creates a new monitor; inspect existing monitors before retrying an unknown response. Requires a V2 workspace API key. V1 (Bubble) API keys are not supported. Monitors and monitoring credits belong to the V2 workspace.
post.x-airscale-credit-cost: 0.1 credit per profile per check. Monitoring admission checks the workspace balance; budget 1,000 credits for a check of 10,000 profiles.

requestBody.description: Choose a check frequency and provide 1–10,000 personal LinkedIn profiles in a JSON body of at most 8 MiB (8,388,608 bytes). For larger payloads, create with fewer profiles and add the remainder to the same monitor in smaller requests.

external_id.description: Your CRM or application identifier. It is echoed in monitor responses and job-change events.
